steps.title: 小区附近的生活和交通
steps.prompt: 小区附近有哪些生活设施？过马路方便吗？这里适合有孩子的家庭吗？为什么？
steps.promptEn: What living facilities are nearby? What is the traffic like, and would this place suit a family with children?
steps.talkHint: 先找超市、马路和儿童活动区，再说明适合谁。

steps.title: 小时候的河边生活
steps.prompt: 作者小时候住在哪里？河边有什么？她夏天常在那里做什么？
steps.promptEn: Where did the writer live, what was by the river, and what did she do there in summer?
steps.talkHint: 观察西北方向、草地、花、河水和儿童活动。

words.example: 我小时候住在北京的西北边，有一条非常有名的河经过那里。我家就住在河边。那里有高高的大树和绿绿的草地。春天，河边的花都开了，看起来特别漂亮。还记得小时候，一到夏天我就去河里游泳。长大以后，遇到什么不开心的事情，我就去河边的树下坐着，听听鸟叫，看看河水，跟遇见的朋友聊聊天儿，难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。那是我最喜欢的地方。
words.examplePinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zhù zài Běijīng de xīběibian, yǒu yì tiáo fēicháng yǒumíng de hé jīngguò nàli. Wǒ jiā jiù zhù zài hébiān. Nàli yǒu gāogāo de dà shù hé lǜlǜ de cǎodì. Chūntiān, hébiān de huā dōu kāi le, kàn qǐlai tèbié piàoliang. Hái jìde xiǎoshíhou, yí dào xiàtiān wǒ jiù qù hé li yóuyǒng. Zhǎngdà yǐhòu, yùdào shénme bù kāixīn de shìqing, wǒ jiù qù hébiān de shù xià zuòzhe, tīngting niǎo jiào, kànkan héshuǐ, gēn yùjiàn de péngyou liáoliao tiānr, nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. Nà shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang.

grammar.title: 介词“根据”
grammar.scene: 观察小区如何根据居民需要发生变化。
grammar.structure: 根据 + 依据/情况 + 行动或结果
grammar.explanation: 介词“根据”在句子中引出事情的依据或理由。

examples.hanzi: 这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒule hěn duō biànhuà.
examples.english: In recent years, the community has changed a lot according to their needs.

examples.hanzi: 根据要求，我们必须参加明天的会议。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yāoqiú, wǒmen bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì.
examples.english: According to the requirements, we must attend tomorrow’s meeting.

examples.hanzi: 老师根据每个学生的兴趣，选择了一样的书。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gēnjù měi gè xuéshēng de xìngqù, xuǎnzé le yíyàng de shū.
examples.english: The teacher chose the same book according to each student’s interests.

examples.hanzi: 我们根据地图选择了最近的景点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gēnjù dìtú xuǎnzé le zuì jìn de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: We chose the nearest scenic spot according to the map.

examples.hanzi: 小区根据老人的需要增加了长椅。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoqū gēnjù lǎorén de xūyào zēngjiā le chángyǐ.
examples.english: The community added benches according to elderly residents’ needs.

grammar.title: 数量重叠“数词+量词+数词+量词”
grammar.scene: 观察人们怎样成组行动或让变化逐步发生。

examples.english: The students’ Chinese level improved day by day.

grammar.title: 固定短语“在……看来”

texts.title: 适合全家住的小区
texts.setting: 在办公室里，王一雪和杨同乐在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 您搬到蓝天小区一段时间了，觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nín bāndào Lántiān Xiǎoqū yí duàn shíjiān le, juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: You've moved to Blue Sky Residential Community for a while. How do you like it?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 小区环境挺好的，附近买东西也很方便，过马路就是超市。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, fùjìn mǎi dōngxi yě hěn fāngbiàn, guò mǎlù jiù shì chāoshì.
lines.english: The community environment is pretty good, and shopping nearby is very convenient—there's a supermarket right across the street.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 平时孩子们在哪儿玩？
lines.pinyin: Píngshí háizimen zài nǎr wán?
lines.english: Where do the kids usually play?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 小区里有很多树，孩子们放学后就在树下做游戏。你想买房子吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoqū li yǒu hěn duō shù, háizimen fàngxué hòu jiù zài shù xià zuò yóuxì. Nǐ xiǎng mǎi fángzi ma?
lines.english: There are many trees in the community; kids play games under the trees after school. Are you thinking of buying a house?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 是。我想买一个大房子，让我爸妈过来跟我一起住。
lines.pinyin: Shì. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè dà fángzi, ràng wǒ bàmā guòlai gēn wǒ yìqǐ zhù.
lines.english: Yes. I want to buy a big house so my parents can come and live with me.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 蓝天小区的老人挺多的，这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
lines.pinyin: Lántiān Xiǎoqū de lǎorén tǐng duō de, zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒule hěn duō biànhuà.
lines.english: There are quite a lot of elderly people in Blue Sky Community. In recent years, the community has made many changes according to their needs.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 真不错！过几天我去蓝天小区看看。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn búcuò! Guò jǐ tiān wǒ qù Lántiān Xiǎoqū kànkan.
lines.english: That's great! I'll go check out Blue Sky Community in a few days.

texts.title: 半个南京人的旅行建议
texts.setting: 在办公室里，王一雪和杨同乐在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 假期我想去南京旅游，但是我不太了解那里。
lines.pinyin: Jiàqī wǒ xiǎng qù Nánjīng lǚyóu, dànshì wǒ bú tài liǎojiě nàli.
lines.english: I'd like to travel to Nanjing over the vacation, but I don't know much about the place.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 我虽然不是南京人，可是我是在南京上的大学，可以说算半个南京人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán bú shì Nánjīng rén, kěshì wǒ shì zài Nánjīng shàng de dàxué, kěyǐ shuō suàn bàn gè Nánjīng rén.
lines.english: Although I'm not originally from Nanjing, I went to university there, so you could say I'm basically half a Nanjing local.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 太好了！你快给我介绍一下南京吧。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ kuài gěi wǒ jièshào yíxià Nánjīng ba.
lines.english: That's great! Please give me a quick introduction to Nanjing.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 南京有两千年以上的历史，有老城、老街，还有很多有名的景点，每年去旅游的游客特别多。
lines.pinyin: Nánjīng yǒu liǎng qiān nián yǐshàng de lìshǐ, yǒu lǎochéng, lǎojiē, hái yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, měi nián qù lǚyóu de yóukè tèbié duō.
lines.english: Nanjing has a history of more than 2,000 years, featuring old cities, historic streets, and many famous scenic spots. A great number of tourists visit every year.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 除了这些以外，你再告诉我一些外地人不知道的地方。
lines.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yǐwài, nǐ zài gàosu wǒ yìxiē wàidìrén bù zhīdào de dìfang.
lines.english: Besides these, tell me some spots that out-of-towners don't know about.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 那太多了，我得一点儿一点儿给您讲。
lines.pinyin: Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng.
lines.english: There are too many of them; I'll have to tell you bit by bit.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 行，下班后我请你吃晚饭，咱们边吃边聊。
lines.pinyin: Xíng, xiàbān hòu wǒ qǐng nǐ chī wǎnfàn, zánmen biān chī biān liáo.
lines.english: Sounds good. I'll treat you to dinner after work, and we can chat over food.

texts.title: 黄河为什么重要
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪和刘小明在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 小明，中国有一条大河，它的名字跟颜色有关系，你知道是什么河吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎomíng, Zhōngguó yǒu yì tiáo dà hé, tā de míngzi gēn yánsè yǒu guānxì, nǐ zhīdào shì shénme hé ma?
lines.english: Xiaoming, there is a major river in China whose name is related to a color. Do you know what river it is?

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 我知道，是黄河！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, shì Huáng Hé!
lines.english: I know, it's the Yellow River!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 你说对了。我再问问你，你知道它为什么叫黄河吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō duì le. Wǒ zài wènwen nǐ, nǐ zhīdào tā wèishénme jiào Huáng Hé ma?
lines.english: You're right. Let me ask you again: do you know why it's called the Yellow River?

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 因为河水看起来是黄色的，所以叫这个名字。黄河是中国最长的河吗？
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi héshuǐ kàn qǐlai shì huángsè de, suǒyǐ jiào zhège míngzi. Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de hé ma?
lines.english: Because the river water looks yellow, that's why it has this name. Is the Yellow River the longest river in China?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 不是。黄河虽然不是最长的河，可是在历史上很重要。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Huáng Hé suīrán bú shì zuì cháng de hé, kěshì zài lìshǐ shang hěn zhòngyào.
lines.english: No. Although the Yellow River is not the longest river, it is historically very important.

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 这个我知道。很久以前，很多中国人都住在黄河边上。
lines.pinyin: Zhège wǒ zhīdào. Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, hěn duō Zhōngguórén dōu zhù zài Huáng Hé biān shang.
lines.english: I know this. Long ago, many Chinese people lived along the Yellow River.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 对。在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
lines.pinyin: Duì. Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māma yíyàng, yǎngle wǒmen jǐ qiān nián.
lines.english: Right. In the eyes of us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother that has nurtured us for thousands of years.

texts.title: 我最喜欢的河边
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪在写日记。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我小时候住在北京的西北边，有一条非常有名的河经过那里。我家就住在河边。那里有高高的大树和绿绿的草地。春天，河边的花都开了，看起来特别漂亮。还记得小时候，一到夏天我就去河里游泳。长大以后，遇到什么不开心的事情，我就去河边的树下坐着，听听鸟叫，看看河水，跟遇见的朋友聊聊天儿，难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。那是我最喜欢的地方。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zhù zài Běijīng de xīběibian, yǒu yì tiáo fēicháng yǒumíng de hé jīngguò nàli. Wǒ jiā jiù zhù zài hébiān. Nàli yǒu gāogāo de dà shù hé lǜlǜ de cǎodì. Chūntiān, hébiān de huā dōu kāi le, kàn qǐlai tèbié piàoliang. Hái jìde xiǎoshíhou, yí dào xiàtiān wǒ jiù qù hé li yóuyǒng. Zhǎngdà yǐhòu, yùdào shénme bù kāixīn de shìqing, wǒ jiù qù hébiān de shù xià zuòzhe, tīngting niǎo jiào, kànkan héshuǐ, gēn yùjiàn de péngyou liáoliao tiānr, nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. Nà shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang.
